title: The family boat
text: The boat needs a second pair of hands this season, and {legacy.parent} has asked for yours.

choices.label: Take your place on the boat
choices.text: Early mornings, cold hands, honest work.

effects.text: You take the oars. By the end of the season the nets come up full.

choices.label: Say no
choices.text: The sea can wait; so can the family.

effects.text: You say no, and {legacy.parent} rows out alone without a word.
